name: io.github.Team-Sequence-Thaumaturge/sadt-mcp
title: SADT — HWP, HWPX & Office Document Transfer MCP
description: Zero-dependency Python MCP server (Stella Actuation Document Transfer) for converting and fitting HWP v5.0 (.hwp), HWPX (.hwpx), Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), HTML, PDF, Markdown, and CSV documents while preserving structure and equations.

tools.name: tdir_probe_files
tools.description: Inspect source documents (.docx, .hwp, .hwpx, .md, .csv, .xlsx, .html) and target HWP template geometry, typography, and slots dynamically.

tools.name: tdir_build_mapping_plan
tools.description: Resolve effective typography and page-budget specifications, map source sections to template slots, and preview elastic layout stages.

tools.name: tdir_execute_conversion
tools.description: Convert documents across HWP, HWPX, DOCX, XLSX, HTML, PDF, Markdown, and CSV using resolved layout constraints.

tools.name: tdir_verify_fidelity_and_layout
tools.description: Check non-whitespace SHA-256 text consistency across generated formats and verify page counts via MS Word COM, LibreOffice, or built-in PDF 1.4 output.

tools.name: tdir_adjust_block_layout
tools.description: Fine-tune individual paragraph merge locks or table column widths and refresh layout telemetry.
